name: zidius’s Real Depth Style
description: zidius’s Real Depth Style is designed to enhance physical realism, material depth, and cinematic surface detail across all types of characters. It focuses on making skin, metal, fabric, and organic surfaces feel tangible, weighty, and physically believable, while preserving the original artistic intent of the prompt. Instead of pushing a specific art style, this LoRA increases visual density, micro-textures, and realistic light interaction, giving images a grounded, film-like presence with richer shadows, more natural highlights, and deeper spatial separation. The overall look aims for a cinematic, high-fidelity realism , where materials appear worn, used, and physically present — from skin pores and cloth fibers to scratches in metal and dust in the air. Recommendation: Trigger word: zidiusReal Create images directly at a resolution of around 1328 × 1944 px . Recommended LoRA strength: start at 0.5 (do not go above 0.75 ). I’m very curious and excited to see what kind of images you will create with this LoRA 🙂
